scope: Static review of specific current offline bindings and retention; no executed counterexample, no complete handback or ledger result claimed
findings: Configured seed occurs among signed inputs and actual mint contains tokB, but those independent predicates do not recompute or bind tokB to that chosen seed; replacing the selected seed with another consumed fee input leaves both predicates satisfiable.
Named wrong-seed control only compares a locally constructed flag list; it does not execute or reject the actual boot seed/token binding.
writeEvidenceTxBody serializes bodyTxL only, omitting witnesses/redeemers/script material from the signed transaction. renderUtxos omits output addresses/raw outputs.
post-utxos snapshots are written immediately after submitTx and before waitConfirmation in the acceptance branch; they do not necessarily retain the later observed target-created successor.
